opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK – September 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that can receive grant funds; applications from individuals are not accepted unless organisational support is provided.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport, supporting events, exchanges, collaborations, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health – 2026

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total for up to three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers and others in health-related fields are also welcome, especially early‑career researchers and those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration experience.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in the UK and Japan, covering travel, conference, and publication costs for projects in medicine and health.
